riot-tracker.name: Riot Rank Tracker
riot-tracker.notes: status is 'validated' but formal /rat-validate competitive/pricing analysis was explicitly skipped at the owner's request, because the product is blocked on a pending Riot API production key application, not because it went through the real scoring process. No fabricated scoring rationale here. price_usd (6.99) is copied from the other trackers (nba-tracker, ufc-tracker) as a placeholder only; real pricing has not been validated against comparable rank-tracker products. Built new and self-contained under plugins/riot-tracker/src, deliberately NOT on plugins/_shared (personal account + personal key is a different domain from the ESPN trackers' public schedule model, per the owner's explicit architecture decision). Two actions: LoL Rank and TFT Rank, both reading league-v4 / tft-league-v1 by puuid. Riot ID -> puuid via account-v1 (continent routing), rank via platform routing. Own snapshot cache in global settings (30 day prune) computes '+LP since 24h/7d' because Riot's API has no historical-rank or per-match LP-delta endpoint anywhere; history only exists from whenever tracking starts, nothing retroactive. sports.notes: The Xeneon Edge companion to the Stream Deck Sports Tracker Ultimate, and a data-layer reuse exercise rather than a rewrite: plugins/_shared/scripts/bundle-sports-widget.mjs compiles espn.ts, sport.ts, event.ts, poller.ts, view.ts and badge.ts's colour helpers plus the ultimate-sports team tables into widgets/_src/sports/lib/sports-data.js with esbuild, so the parsers and cadence rules exist once. All eleven sports and both data models: eight team leagues (805 teams) drawn as score cells, plus UFC, NASCAR and F1 drawn as event cells off parseFightCard/parseRaceField/currentEvent. targetsFor() is deliberately NOT used, because it adds every registered event league to the poll set whether or not it is followed; the widget builds its own target list from the settings so it polls exactly what the user named. Followed things are chosen in the settings panel as [LEAGUE:]ABBR tokens for teams or a bare sport name for UFC/NASCAR/F1 (max 6): the league prefix is load bearing, since 172 of the 805 abbreviations are shared across leagues, so BAL alone is genuinely ambiguous. Cadence is poller.ts's own tiers (45s live / 10m soon / 1h idle) driven by a BASE_TICK_MS ticker calling source.refresh(); packratSource is used only for its last-known-good cache and cold-start paint, because its start() floors at 15 minutes. tierFor and sortForBoard read only .state and .startIso, which SportEvent carries too, so events pace and sort alongside games with no second copy of those rules. Price matches the Stream Deck Sports Tracker Ultimate at $16.99 per the cross-platform price-parity rule, which is also why the event sports had to ship: an 8-of-11 widget at parity price was the inconsistency the owner flagged on 2026-08-22. Against free Corsair first-party single-sport widgets (Football 1141 dl, Baseball 857, Basketball 592, Hockey 585 on 2026-08-08); the differentiator is every sport and one favourites list in a single widget, which none of theirs does. VERIFIED 2026-08-22: inline.py --check, check_structure, layout.mjs at all 8 slot sizes with 3 and 6 followed, and icuewidget validate all clean; live ESPN data confirmed rendering pre, live and final games plus a UFC card, a NASCAR pre-race countdown and an F1 session leader. ESPN 403s headless Chromium specifically (HeadlessChrome in User-Agent or sec-ch-ua) with no CORS header, so every harness run paints the no-data state and cells must render identity without a game; a real browser signature returns 200. home-assistant.name: Home Assistant Panel
home-assistant.notes: Roadmap #10, highest stickiness in the slate. The Stream Deck Home Assistant plugin has 112,701 downloads, so demand is proven and large. Structurally safe from first-party competition: it needs the user's own server address and a long-lived token, which a hardware vendor cannot ask its customers for. The token lives in a textfield property (iCUE persists it) and never in localStorage. REQUIRES the user to allow the null origin in configuration.yaml, because a file:// page sends a literal null Origin and HA does not send CORS headers to arbitrary origins by default; the empty state names this rather than failing silently. network_hosts lists only the default homeassistant.local, since the address is user-supplied and cannot be enumerated in advance. CONFIRMED 2026-08-06 via widgets/harness/functional.mjs: because the request carries an Authorization header it is a non-simple CORS request, so the browser sends an OPTIONS preflight BEFORE the GET. A server that answers the GET but not the preflight fails the whole call and the widget shows its empty state. Setup docs must therefore say cors_allowed_origins, not just 'allow the origin'. BUG 2026-08-21 (customer report, Pascal Tesauri): shipped node_modules had koffi core@3.1.5 against @koromix/koffi-darwin-arm64 and -darwin-x64 both stuck at 3.1.4 -- koffi's loader hard-checks native.version === core.version and throws 'Mismatched native Koffi modules', so every action failed on every Mac, both Apple Silicon and Intel, nothing to do with Stream Deck+. Root cause: package.json had a caret on koffi and the two darwin natives are force-installed by hand per the rollup.config.mjs comment, so a routine `npm install` between builds floated the core (and the win32 native, since npm auto-installs the host match) to a newer koffi release while the hand-installed darwin pair stayed behind. Same defect independently found in workflow-automation and workflow-automation-pro (which had not yet been reported). Fixed 2026-08-21: koffi and all three @koromix/koffi-* natives pinned to exact 3.1.5 (no caret) in this package.json plus workflow-automation, workflow-automation-pro, plugins/_wm and plugins/_wf; rebuilt and repacked as 1.0.0.1. Hardened against recurrence: rollup.config.mjs's assert-koffi-binary build guard now errors if any native's version does not match core (previously only checked the .node file existed), and tools/qa/checks_build.py gained build.koffi_version_mismatch to catch it in the shipped .sdPlugin tree even if a build guard is ever skipped -- both verified by fault-injecting the exact reported mismatch and confirming they fail loud, then restoring. STATUS FIELD IS STALE: Pascal purchased this product, which is only possible if Elgato already approved and published it, so 'submitted' here has not tracked the real Maker Console state since approval. Needs a status correction to 'published' plus marketplace_slug once someone checks Maker Console; left the status field alone here rather than guessing at what wasn't verified directly. BUG 2026-08-22 (Pascal's follow-up): even after the koffi fix, layout restore failed on every window with 'macOS refused to move that window', sometimes crashing the plugin outright. Root cause was unrelated to koffi: plugins/_wm/src/native/darwin.ts's listWindows() pulls each AXUIElementRef out of a CFArray via CFArrayGetValueAtIndex, which hands back a borrowed reference, then calls CFRelease on the array itself -- freeing the very handles just stored on each WindowRef before restore() got to use them. Snap/Nudge never hit this because they read AXFocusedWindow directly, bypassing the array; Cycle's focusWindow was silently exposed to the same bug but never loud about it since it ignores AXUIElementPerformAction's return value. Fixed by CFRetain-ing each element before the array release. Shipped as 1.0.0.2, also backported to window-manager (Lite) 1.0.0.1 which shares the same native layer and was never reported. FEATURE 2026-08-22: shipped 1.1.0.0 in response to Pascal's customization request (thirds, halves, two-thirds, custom coordinates for Snap). Added top/bottom halves, left/center/right thirds, left/right two-thirds, and a custom position with typed X/Y/W/H percentages, all in plugins/_wm/src/geometry.ts + badge.ts (shared code). Deliberately kept Pro-only per owner decision (Lite should stay 'basic and boring'): the new SnapPosition values and snapRect() custom param exist in the shared engine both tiers bundle, but only Pro's ui/snap.html and snap.js expose them in the Property Inspector, so Lite's dropdown still shows just its original 4 options. Not built: 'a specific application for each position' (an authored/named layout with per-slot app assignment, distinct from the existing capture-based Layout action) and a visual drag-and-drop layout editor -- both scoped as a materially larger follow-on feature, not attempted here. PRICE CHANGE 2026-08-22: owner approved raising $6.99 to $8.99 alongside the 1.1.0.0 feature update, on the reasoning that price changes are reversible per CLAUDE.md (unlike the paid/free choice, which is not) so this is a low-risk test rather than a one-way call.
